ruleDefinitions.name: Lsass Memory Dump via Comsvcs DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects adversaries leveraging the MiniDump export function from comsvcs.dll via rundll32 to perform a memory dump from lsass. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, SourceImage, CallTrace

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*comsvcs\\\.dll.*"))
